Job Description The BAE Systems IT Internship Program provides a broad and integrated understanding of enterprise level service delivery. The program consists of a 12-week hands-on experience with mentors and Service Leaders. There are multiple positions available to fulfill the following skillsets: software development, building reusable automation, system architecture, data engineering, software development, graphic user interface design, end to end user experience, and other project related work.

As an intern you will participate in our nationwide Internship & Co-Op Program, LEAP, where you will have the opportunity to Learn, Engage, Apply, and Progress within the company. You will also have access to additional benefits such as, networking with BAE Systems employees and other students, participating in exciting real world projects, joining exclusive informational sessions with senior leaders, and expanding mentorship opportunities and career development.

This is an internship during the summer of 2026, and interns should expect the duration to be 12 weeks. Based on performance during the summer session, and with the discretion of the leadership team, there is a possibility of extending the internship to part time during the school year.

The ideal intern should be able to perform the following tasks:
• Perform data analysis and extract useful business insights
• Identify actionable insights, suggest recommendations and help influence the direction of the business by communicating results to cross-functional groups
• Suggest improvements in the tools and techniques to help scale the team
• Experience working in an agile environment, with distributed teams
• Help develop internal wiki for cross-training within SharePoint/Teams
The Internship consists of the following components
• Program Length – 12 Weeks – commitment required for the full 12-week program
• Internship Dates – May 26th – August 14th, 2026
• Hybrid work environment with 3 days per week onsite at a BAE Systems site of Falls Church, VA.
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
• Compensation – The internship is paid on an hourly basis.
Required Education, Experience, & Skills
• Major Degree – Computer Science / Information Technology / Cybersecurity / Data Science / Information Systems
• Experience in solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches (or equivalent)
• Curious, self-driven, analytical and excited to play with data
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment
• Student Status – Rising Junior, Senior, Recent Graduate (within one year) or Graduate Student (Graduating May or Dec.)
Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills Well qualified candidates contain some of the following skills:
• Knowledge of security tools such as Splunk, ArcSight, Nessus Security Center, CrowdStrike, CyberArk, etc
• Comfortable performing system administration on a shell/command line interface
• Development experience in at least one scripting language (R, Python, Bash, Java, PowerShell, etc.)
• Update and validate the Software install\support documents
• Familiarity Software development lifecycle to: gather requirements, refine design, build, verify build and validate build
• Familiarity with eDirectory, Identity Management Concepts, DevSecOps Environments, Linux OS, or Active Directory
• Familiarity with one or more UNIX operating systems, such as RedHat
• Experience with User Interface redesigning, wireframing, free hand mockups, and testing practices
• Collaboration skills with UX Designer, Content Strategist, UX Writer, Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Developers
• Machine Learning experience
• Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
• Excellent Customer service skills at all levels

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $49592 - $68993

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Temporary employees generally are not eligible for BAE Systems benefits, but can elect to participate in the 401(k) savings plan. Temporary employees working 20+ hours per week are eligible for medical benefits, the employee assistance program, and business travel accident insurance.
About BAE Systems, Inc.BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

An internship at Don’t Panic Labs is an opportunity to experience engineering-focused software product development in a fun and supportive environment.

This is no ordinary internship. Interns work alongside our team and our clients, which means they must be able to articulate their ideas clearly and thoughtfully. Our team has the freedom to work the way that best fits their strengths, so there’s little supervision. Interns must be self-starters to succeed.

Our team is constantly learning because the industry is always changing. Interns learn alongside our software engineers, architects, and designers. We provide all the tools needed to “build smart”; it’s an intern's responsibility to bring their tenacity and desire to learn.

Applications will be accepted through Sunday, September 28, 2025 (11:59PM CT).

Description

SAIC is seeking a Junior Frontend Software Engineer in Huntsville, AL.

The Network, System Integration and Test Environment (NSITE) is a Government owned, managed, and developed software suite. NSITE is used by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), Joint Services, and numerous labs in support of continued testing of systems employed for defense of the United States and our Allies. The NSITE software provides data collection, situational awareness, and analysis capabilities to a wide range of users who benefit from NSITE’s ability to act as an independent third-party truth teller. The NSITE team has in-depth experience in Tactical Data Links (TDL), Ballistic Missile Defense System (BMDS) Test, Enterprise Information Technology, Software and Systems Engineering and Information Assurance.

Duties and Responsibilities:
• Responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining the NSITE software application.
• Work on an agile development team where success is defined by the ability to understand your path forward, effectively communicate that path, and complete the task inherent to that path in a timely matter.
• Communicate with leadership and the customer to ensure a common understanding of requirements.
• Document your work for the benefit of your teammates, the user, leadership, and posterity.
• Identify and solve challenging problems by writing performant, clean, and practical code.

Qualifications

Education Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and zero (0) years’ experience; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree (per contract vehicle).

Clearance Requirements:
• Must possess an active Interim Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain a Secret security clearance; US Citizenship required.

Required Qualifications:
• Experience working with Software Design and Development.
• Proficient in C#, and in Microsoft .NET.
• Familiarity with WPF and MVVM patterns.
• Ability to understand what makes an intuitive User Interface (UI).
• Knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including Agile methodologies.
• Ability to analyze a requirement, generate a design, and produce efficient, robust, and testable software.
• Ability to understand, and evaluate WPF / C# code and develop corresponding unit test(s).

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with WPF based control sets such as DevExpress, Telerik, or Infragistics.
• Understanding of and experience with secure programming techniques.
• Knowledge of tactical and simulation data links (specifically Link 16, JREAP, DIS, VMF, CMF and XML).
• Experience working with Microsoft Visual Studio.
• Experience with using Git version control and Gitlab as software management tools.
• Currently have an Information Assurance Technical certification (CompTia A+, Net+, or Sec+) or the ability to obtain one.

Travel Required:
• Less than 10% annually.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

CVS Health’s Adjudication & Client Experience Engineering organization is seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer to join our Application Production Support Team, providing Level 1–3 support for critical myPBM business applications. This role is essential in ensuring the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of systems that directly serve our PBM (Pharmacy Benefit Management) business customers.

As a Software Development Engineer, you will work closely with fellow engineers as well as product, design, and operational teams to triage, troubleshoot, and resolve daily production issues. You will be responsible for addressing application incidents, identifying root causes, implementing permanent fixes, and driving process improvements to reduce recurring issues. Your work will support business continuity, customer satisfaction, and the overall operational excellence of our digital platforms.

In addition to support responsibilities, you will play an active role in facilitating Break fix existing codebases to improve application stability, scalability, and performance as our membership and transaction volumes continue to grow. This includes designing and implementing new features, contributing to technical architecture, and helping advance the engineering roadmap across our adjudication and client experience systems.

This position requires strong technical expertise, solid problem‑solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a high‑demand production environment. You will help guide technical direction, contribute to engineering innovation, and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality digital solutions for our customers

Key Responsibilities
• Provide Level 1–3 application production support for myPBM business customers, including monitoring, incident resolution, and proactive system health checks.
• Analyze and troubleshoot complex application and systems issues; perform root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions.
• Collaborate with engineering, product, QA, operations, and business teams to ensure timely and accurate resolution of production incidents.
• Code fix, optimize, and improve existing codebases to enhance system reliability, stability, and scalability.
• Perform debugging, and validation across distributed application environments.
• Participate in on-call rotations as needed to support critical production services.
• Contribute to the technical roadmap, driving innovation and continuous improvement within the engineering ecosystem.
• Document solutions, operational procedures, and knowledge-base articles to support cross-team learning and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience in application production support (Level 1–3), incident management, and troubleshooting of enterprise systems.
• 1+ years of Software Development Engineering experience using Java, Oracle, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
• 1+ Experience with distributed systems, APIs, databases, and cloud technologies (Azure and GCP).
• Familiarity with monitoring tools, logging frameworks, and IT operations processes.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
• Excellent analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefits management, or similar regulated industries.
• Experience with automation, monitoring, and incident management tools.
• Knowledge using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Github Copilot, Windsurf, etc) to accelerate development workflows

Education:
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience /specialized training/relevant professional qualification

Anticipated Weekly Hours
40

Time Type
Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$61,800.00 - $123,600.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

AST provides trusted strategic and tactical signals intelligence (SIGINT) solutions that protect the interests of the U.S. and its partners. AST’s work in areas such as high-capacity broadband communications, signal processing and analysis, tactical SIGINT and airborne intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and wireless communications continually challenges our extraordinary engineers to solve problems and make the world a safer place. AST’s work environment is passionate, highly collaborative and provides engineers the freedom to strengthen and expand their skills, explore new and innovative ideas all while embracing integrity, diversity, and work-life balance.

The AST Engineering Center is currently seeking a Software Engineer Intern to be an integral part of project teams that develop systems that provide integrated sensor and signal processing products in support of intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance that protect your family, your nation, and enhance global security. In this position, you will apply your C++ software development experience to design, implement, integrate, and test software applications supporting advanced high-capacity systems that process modern communications for the U.S. Government.
• ** The work location is our Silicon Valley Office located in north San Jose, CA.

What You Will Do:
• Develop object-oriented C++ software solutions in a Linux environment.
• Put your understanding of the software development lifecycle to use
• Write Python, MATLAB, and/or similar scripting/programming languages in a Linux software development environment.
• Work independently and in a small team environment.

What You Will Learn:
• You will learn COMINT/ELINT principles and concepts and work side-by-side with industry recognized technical leaders to develop and implement state of the art systems.
• You will learn software engineering in all aspects - requirements, design, implementation, testing
• You will learn how to work on a fast-paced team to tackle difficult challenges in an ever-evolving field

• Experience with Unix/Linux and related utilities
• Familiarity with using version control and defect tracking tools (Git, JIRA, etc.).
• Knowledge of network and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP).

Summer 2026 Software Developer Internship

Praxis Engineering, a GDIT company, provides cutting-edge technology capabilities and unmatched expertise to deliver mission-critical solutions that drive impact and support customer needs.

What sets a Praxis internship experience apart from other organizations in the industry?

Praxis Engineering, a GDIT Company, is seeking top performing college students for our 10-week Summer 2026 Internship Program. This is an opportunity to gain practical hands-on experience in at least one of our key technical focus areas, which include Full-Spectrum Cyberspace Operations, Data Science/Machine Learning/AI, and High-Performance Computing. The selected individuals will work closely with experienced mentors on Praxis’ in-house software project(s).

Over the course of the internship, students will focus on the following three items:
• Building hands-on experience with modern software and technologies
• Learning best practices in the software development lifecycle and how to work efficiently as a team
• Creating and delivering professional-grade demos and presentations – critical skills for well-rounded engineers

This is meaningful internal research and development work that offers a glimpse into what life at Praxis is like!

What you will need
• At least 2 years of education towards a Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or similar Engineering degree (we will consider strong candidates from any major with at least 1 year of Computer Science coursework)
• Demonstrated experience and/or training in software development and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, C/C++, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript.
• Demonstrated experience and/or training in software design/development best practices and methodologies.
• Passion for solving complex software engineering problems, continuously learning, and working effectively in a collaborative team environment!
• Interest in developing engineering soft skills like demoing, building presentations, and public speaking
• US Citizenship required

How we will evaluate you

At the conclusion of our 10-week program, successful interns will have demonstrated:
• Excellent technical aptitude and an ability to learn and absorb new things
• Reliability and accountability: saying what you’re going to do and doing what you say
• Effective collaboration with Praxis mentors and other intern team members
• Compliance with all relevant Praxis/GDIT policies and processes

Praxis interns are paid and full-time (40 hours/week) for 10 consecutive weeks. Take the first step and apply today!

Description

SAIC is seeking an experienced and passionate Junior-level React Native Developer to join our dynamic development team in Ashburn, VA. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in mobile development, particularly with the React Native framework, and will play a critical role in designing and implementing high-quality mobile applications.

This position requires on-site work in Ashburn, VA 5 days per week for the first year of employment.

Job Responsibilities:
• Design and develop engaging, intuitive and reusable React Native components.
• Use modern software engineering tools including VS Code, Gitlab, and Atlassian Suites for ticketing and documentation, development, and testing software.
• Present solutions at formal and informal design reviews in conjunction with the Technical Lead, and document the design according to the Government’s system lifecycle methodology.
• Understand how to interface with Native code on Android and iOS from React Native.
• Code unit tests and end-to-end test using the framework of choice of the team.
• Participate in daily scrums and code reviews.
• Keep up to date with React Native technology updates and trends.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related engineering field with 2+ years of technical experience.
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in mobile development and React Native.
• Proven Mobile development experience using.
• React Native.
• Native iOS, Android.
• Some Detox experience.
• Proficient in Typescript and JavaScript.
• Constructing and debugging CI/CD build Pipelines for mobile targets.
• Strong experience with Redux, Flux, or other state management libraries.
• Understanding how REST APIs work.
• Understanding of Micro Service Architecture.
• Unit Test and End-to-End test development.

Desired Skills and Experience
• Experience using RTK Query is a plus.
• Understanding how containerization and orchestration Tools work.

• Experience working on an agile team such as Scrum.

• Ability to work in a high-pressure, tight-deadline environment.
• Must be able to multitask efficiently and progressively and work comfortably in an ever-changing data environment.
• Master’s degree in computer science or related engineering field is a plus.

Customer Requirements

About the Job

As an engineer within the Database platform team, you will bring the breadth and depth of your infrastructure knowledge and abilities to bear in supporting the data-oriented needs of the developers and development teams who build the tools that keep the enterprise moving forward.

While your knowledge and skillsets will focus on various database technologies and database management systems, you will have a strong understanding of infrastructure as a whole, including the tools for implementing infrastructure using automation, infrastructure as code.

What You’ll Do
• Apply engineering standard methodologies to analyze and develop software solutions for database platforms, both on-premises and in the cloud
• Work to automate and improve the developer experience for our engineers
• Proficiency in DevOps and Agile principles
• Leverages established coding standards, best practices, and automation capabilities to develop solutions to support our users
• Identify technical problems and develop software solutions and/or automation capabilities

What You’ll Bring to the Role
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
• At least 2 years of working experience in the field
• Experience with database platforms, both relational and NoSQL - On-prem and Cloud (Sybase, Dynamo, Mongo, Timestream, Neptune are preferred platforms)
• Experience with AWS Cloud Services, containerized applications and container orchestration
• Experience with Linux based platforms, and modern programming and scripting languages (Python)
• Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code frameworks (Terraform)
• Experience working with DevOps, CICD, GitOps, Agile methodologies
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation and how to apply it with services such as Gitlab CI
• Experience with monitoring and performance management/tuning of systems
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Problem solver who enjoys learning on the job and thinking outside of the box

Skills You Have
• Adaptive Communication: Formulates strategies to be used to convey complex information about services, products, systems, or processes to targeted audiences; communicates and liaises between technical and non-technical audiences.
• Analytical Thinking: Organizes and compares various aspects of a situation to comprehend and identify key or underlying complex issues through the use of quantitative data and analysis; leverages strong business acumen, problem solving, and interpersonal skills to think critically about situations from multiple perspectives and consistently seeks ways to improve processes.
• CI/CD Processes: Involves expertise in implementing and maintaining automated testing processes for software delivery pipelines. Requires knowledge of version control systems. Builds tools and continuous integration servers to enable continuous testing, integration, and delivery of software products. Collaborates with developers to ensure that automated tests are executed at each stage of the pipeline, identifies and reports issues, and provides feedback to improve the overall quality of the applications.
• Cloud & IT Infrastructure: Embraces, prioritizes, and applies DevOps principles and mindset to cybersecurity services and capabilities; leverages understanding of enterprise IT environment from operating system to networks and domain services and orchestrates applications and infrastructure through a pipeline approach.
• DevOps: Applies continuous integration and delivery to implement applications and services at a higher velocity.
